description: Unofficial OMORI fan-art companion based on the monochrome Headspace identity. Original gentle animations include sketchbook drawing, arranging black-and-white toy keys, folding a paper map and quiet articulated running. Opaque black long-sleeve underlayer and simple closed shoes are modest original adaptations. No weapons, distress or self-harm themes; not affiliated with OMOCAT.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
